remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place: 1946." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "On backing: In ink by O'Keeffe 'Starlight Night, Lake George' – 22. Initials [not verified]. Black mountain reflected in deep blue-green water. Deep blue sky with round stars." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates ☆{5star} [not verified]. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks c. 1922. Backing inscription dates 1922. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Starlight Night, Lake George

description: A rippling lake reflects a set of dark red mountains and dark blue sky dotted with yellow stars. Across the lake, two points of yellow light glow on the opposite shore.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
